sar.narrative: On 2016-12-02, an unauthorized online transaction totaling $1,000.03 USD was initiated against card account C10434-K1 belonging to customer C10434. The transaction (ID 3506725) was routed through an unverified Windows 10 workstation (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768) that had no prior connection to the cardholder profile. The real-time detection model scored the event at 0.90 risk probability due to sudden transaction size escalation and foreign browser characteristics. Sentinel AI immediately prompted cardholder C10434 via secure out-of-band communication protocols to validate authorization. The cardholder explicitly denied initiating the transaction, confirming that their credentials or card data had been compromised. The financial exposure stands at $1,000.03 USD, exceeding the regulatory reporting threshold established by FinCEN guidelines. Pursuant to bank policy rules R2 and Section 3a, card C10434-K1 was permanently blocked and scheduled for immediate reissue. The suspicious activity reflects card-not-present fraud executed via credential acquisition. This report is submitted to document the illicit event and assist law enforcement intelligence gathering.
